answers:
[goal]
Make the Pixel Arena backend match `./docs`, fixing every cause behind the failing integration test.

[action]
Three defects fixed, no test files touched, no new dependencies (stdlib `decimal` only):
- `arena_server/config/loader.py`: the JSON file was applied after the environment, so the file won. Order is now DEFAULTS < JSON file < `ARENA_<KEY>` env, as `docs/CONFIG.md` says.
- `arena_server/persistence/codec.py`: `decode` dropped `credits`, so every loaded profile came back with 0 credits. It now restores them, as `docs/ECONOMY.md` requires.
- `arena_server/economy/payout.py`: rounding ran on binary floats, so an exact half could land just below the tie and round down. It now uses `Decimal` with `ROUND_HALF_UP` to the nearest ten. This one was not reproduced as a failure; it is a hardening of the documented "halves always round up" rule.

[result]
Full suite, `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`:
```
.............
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Ran 13 tests in 0.015s

OK
```
The integration test (expects 100 + 1590) is among the 13 and needed both the loader and codec fixes to pass. Spot check of the documented rounding examples printed `1430 1590 1160` (1425 -> 1430, 1585 -> 1590, and 1155 at multiplier 1.1 -> 1160).

Not done:
- No new regression tests were added; I read "existing tests stay as they are" conservatively and ran out the time budget on the fixes.
- The integration test was not run before the fixes, so its original failure is inferred from the code, not observed.
- The other packages (matchmaking, chat, store and the rest) were not audited; the docs only cover config and economy.

Assumptions: missing `credits` in an old save decodes as 0; `legacy_payout.py` is left alone because it is marked deprecated and unused by the live economy. No browser tabs or apps were opened.

[next]
Add unit tests for env-over-file precedence, the credits save/load round trip, and half-up rounding with a fractional multiplier.
